name: schoolane
description: Role-aware school context and governed curriculum drafting through the authenticated SchooLane MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Review and draft curriculum within your role
interface.longDescription: SchooLane gives Codex a governed school-operations connection. Inspect only the school and curriculum allowed by the signed-in user's current role, audit teaching plans, and create or update curriculum drafts without bypassing human review, approval, or publishing.
defaultPrompt: Show me the classes and curriculum I can access
Review my term scheme and identify planning gaps
Draft next week's lesson plan for one of my classes
